content.tex: Section B
MODELLING CROSSED POLES
You are advised to spend no more than 45 minutes on this section.
In this task you will be modelling the heights of triangles made below two poles when they cross.
Each triangle is made from 2 poles that lean between vertical posts.

One end of each pole rests on the ground and the other end rests against a vertical post. The posts are \(d\) metres apart on horizontal ground. The poles cross each other \(h\) metres above the ground.
In this task you will find Pythagoras’theorem useful.
